data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order: open Attractions, enter and pick the destination, choose a date, search, open the attraction, check availability, then set guest/ticket counts and proceed. It names destination, date and guest counts as parameters, but it leaves out the filters/sort step and the filters parameter, and adds a time-slot parameter. The steps are concrete enough to automate apart from that missing filter step.
